name: Goniometric ROM
description: Clinician-measured joint range of motion using a goniometer, reported in degrees. Compare to contralateral side or published normative values.
shirleySays: Intra-rater ICC 0.87–0.99; inter-rater ICC 0.84–0.90 (lower for small joints). SEM ~4–5° for large joints. No universal MCID — context-dependent; ~5–10° common clinical threshold. Inclinometry is superior for spinal ROM.

scoring.mcidNote: ~5–10° common clinical threshold; compare to contralateral limb or normative tables (Norkin & White 2009)
